evidence.title: Speaker Copilot: The stage timing copilot for live speakers | Product Hunt

name: Speaker Copilot
summary: Product Hunt listing for a free PWA that paces live talks: auto-advancing timed sections, vibration cues, SOS and Q&A card decks.
description: Product page for Speaker Copilot, a PWA that splits a talk into timed sections and advances them automatically with a vibration cue, with one-tap clue, SOS and Q&A card decks and rehearsal scoring. Built with React, Vite and Tailwind, LocalStorage only — no login, no backend, works offline, open source.
contains: auto-advancing timed sections with a vibration cue on each transition
clue, SOS and Q&A phrase card decks
rehearsal tracking scored on five criteria toward a readiness target
no login, no backend; talks stay in LocalStorage; works offline and installs to the home screen
